ev.q: The earworm songs tended to have a faster tempo

1.why: C段。quicker ↔ a faster tempo。B slower 意思相反。

ev.q: their melodies usually followed a fairly common overall shape, rising and then falling

2.why: C段。typical outline ↔ a fairly common overall shape。D irregular 是陷阱：原文说旋律里有一些 unusual leaps，但那是“独特之处”（题干已经说了 with some distinctive features），整体轮廓是常见的。

ev.q: they had also enjoyed greater success in the charts and had been played more often on the radio

3.why: C段末句。popular ↔ greater success in the charts … played more often on the radio。F obscure（冷门的）意思相反。

ev.q: a memory system that helps us to learn sequences, such as the steps of a task or the words of a sentence, by rehearsing them automatically

4.why: D段。repeats sequences without conscious effort ↔ rehearsing them automatically。H forgets 意思相反。

ev.q: only a small minority find them distressing

5.why: E段。Most people do not find the experience troubling ↔ the majority describe them as neutral or even pleasant, and only a small minority find them distressing。J enjoyable 放进去变成“大多数人不觉得愉快”，与 even pleasant 矛盾。

ev.q: chewing interferes with the silent movements of the mouth and throat that accompany imagining a song

6.why: F段。keeping the mouth busy ↔ chewing interferes with the silent movements of the mouth and throat。L mind 是陷阱：F段另一个方法（做字谜）才是让大脑忙起来，嚼口香糖针对的是嘴部动作。

ev.q: a direct translation of the German word Ohrwurm

7.why: A段。the source of a term ↔ a direct translation of the German word Ohrwurm。

ev.q: they are especially likely to occur when the mind is not fully occupied

8.why: B段。situations in which earworms are particularly frequent ↔ especially likely to occur when the mind is not fully occupied: while walking, doing housework…。E段讲的是罕见的严重情况，不是“容易出现的场合”。

ev.q: Deliberately trying not to think about it, on the other hand, tends to make it return more often.

9.why: F段末句。one method of stopping an earworm can have the opposite effect ↔ Deliberately trying not to think about it … tends to make it return more often。

ev.q: Advertisers have long tried to write jingles that will stay in customers' heads, and teachers use songs to help children remember

10.why: G段。earworms being encouraged for useful purposes ↔ advertisers … jingles that will stay in customers' heads … teachers use songs to help children remember。

ev.q: about nine out of ten respondents experienced earworms at least once a week

11.why: A段。a large majority ↔ about nine out of ten；every week ↔ at least once a week。

ev.q: compared a hundred songs that had frequently been named as earworms with a hundred others that were similar in popularity and style but had rarely been named

12.why: C段。songs often reported as earworms ↔ frequently been named as earworms；similar songs that seldom were ↔ similar … but had rarely been named。A 是 Reading 大学的实验（F段），不是 Jakubowski。

ev.q: they offer a rare chance to study the thoughts that arise spontaneously in the mind

13.why: G段。thoughts that arise by themselves ↔ thoughts that arise spontaneously；a way of studying ↔ a rare chance to study。F 与E段相反：严重情况很罕见。
